excludedRuns: The earlier final/final2 fleet series are excluded. Concurrent core fuzzy-matching/dependency edits were discovered during final2, including one process exit before Jasmine startup. Accepted fleet runs use an isolated core checkout at the stated revision and an isolated copy of its pinned fuzzy-native dependency.
fleetStateNotes: Outside the frozen symbol/core variants, the post-run status check found only outline-view changes in its lazily created view and spec, while Outline remained closed. scrollmap Git metadata could not supply a revision; its package/lib content fingerprint is recorded.
validationNotes: During concurrent fuzzy changes, one current-core Outline Unicode assertion returned '[object Object]'. Isolated actual-DOM checks passed, and the subsequent complete Outline suite passed 87/87 without a change from this task. The initial failed current-core run is not counted as a pass.

method.fleet: Before/after/after/before in fresh renderers per operation. Each process opens the private file twice: middle and 100 rows before EOF. 43 explicitly activated packages, real SOFiSTiK LSP, Outline closed, complete 195778-symbol cache required before each 60-input sequence at 60 Hz. Input is followed by 180 wheel events and 6 seconds observation. Provider timeout is 10 seconds. No forced GC.
method.isolation: Timings run sequentially without concurrent tests/profiles. The symbol package variants are frozen and the final runtime files match the measured candidate byte for byte. Private input and paths are excluded; file hash, edited output hash, syntax revision/input/extent checks are retained.
method.micro: Electron Node mode, actual Point/Range implementation, 200000 generated symbols, 30 edits per case; shallow and long enclosing ranges, start/middle/end, column/Enter/delete-line and 2000 column edits per transaction. Preparation uses the same cooperative runner. Every final coordinate hash agrees between variants.
method.limits: Two fresh processes per variant/operation: descriptive samples, not population tail guarantees. No physical display latency measurement. This compares against the preceding JS model, not native Superstring. Multiline changes still update the affected suffix; pruning is not a lazy interval tree.
